title: /api/profiles and /api/providers/profile_chains name the same profiles
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/profiles' > /tmp/qa_p.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers' > /tmp/qa_c.json; python3 -c "import json; p=set(json.load(open('/tmp/qa_p.json'))['profiles']); c=set(json.load(open('/tmp/qa_c.json'))['profile_chains']); assert p==c, (sorted(p-c), sorted(c-p))"

title: /api/routing/status covers every profile in /api/profiles
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/qa_r.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/profiles' > /tmp/qa_p.json; python3 -c "import json; r=set(json.load(open('/tmp/qa_r.json'))['per_profile']); p=set(json.load(open('/tmp/qa_p.json'))['profiles']); assert not (p-r), sorted(p-r)"

title: health reports every profile and no dead provider
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/health' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['status']=='ok'; assert len(d['profiles'])>=1; assert all(v.get('state')!='dead' for v in d['providers'].values()), [k for k,v in d['providers'].items() if v.get('state')=='dead']"

title: /api/usage/totals agrees with /api/usage/stats.totals
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' > /tmp/qa_s.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/totals' > /tmp/qa_t.json; python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('/tmp/qa_s.json'))['totals']; t=json.load(open('/tmp/qa_t.json')); assert s['requests']==t['requests'], (s['requests'],t['requests']); assert abs(s['cost']-t['cost'])<0.01, (s['cost'],t['cost'])"
